Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final comparison step by swapping the birthdates of the two directors. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved Orestis Laskos's birthdate (1907) and Sam Irvin's birthdate (1956), the Planner incorrectly stated in the final answer that Orestis Laskos was born on 1956-06-14 and Sam Irvin was born on 1907-11-11. This misattribution of dates led to the logically incorrect conclusion that the director of *Allos Gia To Ekatommyrio* was born later, when in reality, Sam Irvin (born 1956) was born later than Orestis Laskos (born 1907).
